resume_brief: Research task: identify all remaining unnamed shows in the Cartoon Network gigaleak. COMPLETED 2026-10-12. Found 14 new shows via social media investigation (Instagram carousels, X posts, TikTok/IG reels): Camp Lazlo, Courage the Cowardly Dog, Chowder, My Gym Partner's a Monkey, Scooby-Doo Mystery Incorporated, Teen Titans Go!, Top Cat (all with visual confirmation of model sheets/rigs), plus Cow and Chicken, OK K.O., Animaniacs, Johnny Test, Total Drama (reported). Also found Codename: Kids Next Door Production Bible (2002) on Internet Archive. Total now 30 shows catalogued. Updated CN-GIGALEAK-CATALOG.md with Tiers 5-6, new asset types (production fonts, exposure guides, mouth charts), updated B2 layout and pull batches. Source status: Drive links and Google Docs being struck for copyright; file-sharing mirrors partially down; Internet Archive items (Johnny Bravo, KND bibles) stable.
notes: 30 shows now catalogued across 6 tiers. New asset types added: production fonts (GUMBAL ROUNDED), exposure/composition guides, mouth charts/visemes (Dexter 1995). Conflicting report on Steven Universe (in news coverage but one X walkthrough says notably lacking). Nickelodeon also hit with separate 500GB leak (GhostyTongue) - not our scope but noted.
